messages:
Maya Chen: kicking off canary for release v2.3.7 to prod-east, 10% traffic. tagging runbooks.
Deploy-bot: DEPLOY STARTED: release=v2.3.7 env=prod-east canary=10% link=https://deploys.redwood.internal/1742501234 :rocket:
Alex R.: noted. I'll watch /generation and /infer metrics. @Samir pls lean in on latency dashboards.
Samir Patel: on it. pulling up traces... looks like a small spike on worker-3 already, +30ms p95.
Lia Gomez: FYI added pointer to scoped backout doc in runbooks: https://confluence.redwood.com/display/ENG/rollback-flightplan_v2.3
Maya Chen: if errors >0.5% for 5m, we hold and either pin to v2.3.6 or roll traffic back. decision tree in runbook.
Oncall Bot: ALERT: 20m window: error_rate /generate = 0.8% (current) :warning:
Alex R.: hold canary. DEPLOY PAUSED. Can someone pin traffic back to stable?
Deploy-bot: ACTION: canary paused. To rollback run:
``
# pin stable
/deploy pin --version v2.3.6 --env prod-east
# scale down canary
/k8s scale deploy canary-v2.3.7 --replicas=0 -n prod-east
``
Samir Patel: executing pin now.
Samir Patel: pinned to v2.3.6, confirmed 100% traffic stable. p95 returned to baseline.
Lia Gomez: filing postmortem checklist item: add targeted test for worker-3 config drift. link to evals: https://evals.redwood.com/run/222
Maya Chen: great. push a small follow-up patch to canary config, re-run canary tomorrow 10:00 UTC. I'll update release notes and change window.
Alex R.: thanks all. tagging ops-oncall for handoff. :thumbsup:
Oncall Bot: HANDOFF: ops-oncall notified. Runbook used: rollback-flightplan_v2.3. Tickets: #INC-8321
